title: On Exposing the fault in the third beam
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：expose　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 expose 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the guide ① exposed the fault in the third beam in silence, and every traveller in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the guide ② exposes the fault in the third beam twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ expose the fault in the third beam at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ exposed the fault in the third beam before — a line in the guidebook for July 1946 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Exposing the fault in the third beam in silence, the guide said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ expose the dealings of the whole office twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Expose the dealings of the whole office at once and never mention it again.

By 1959 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook, and a new traveller from the next valley ⑧ exposes the dealings of the whole office in silence every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ledge, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ exposed the fault in the third beam again when nobody else would.

⑩ To expose the fault in the third beam, my mother said in 1964, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, somebody exposes the fault in the third beam twice over again and somebody must expose the fault in the third beam in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 暴露（一般过去式 exposed the fault in the third beam：1952 年向导头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 暴露（一般现在 exposes the fault in the third beam：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 暴露（不定式 to expose the fault in the third beam：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 暴露（过去完成时 had exposed the fault in the third beam：1946 年七月的旅行手册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 暴露（动名词 exposing the fault in the third beam 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 揭露（expose the dealings of the whole office：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去揭露揭出整个事务所的勾当）
G. v. 揭露（expose the dealings of the whole office：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 暴露（后段两处：新来的旅人照例 exposes the dealings of the whole office，而母亲又一次 exposed the fault in the third beam）

answers.why: expose 意为“暴露”，1952 年向导一言不发地暴露露出第三根梁上的毛病，那是山谷里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 exposed。
expose 意为“暴露”，自那以后向导来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 exposes。
expose 意为“暴露”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯暴露露出第三根梁上的毛病”，此处为不定式 to expose the fault in the third beam。
expose 意为“暴露”，旅行手册里 七月 那行字说明早在 1959 年之前就有人暴露过，故用过去完成时 had exposed。
expose 意为“暴露”，向导说“暴露露出第三根梁上的毛病这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 exposing the fault in the third beam 作主语。
expose 意为“揭露”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去揭露揭出整个事务所的勾当”，should ever 之后用原形 expose the dealings of the whole office。
expose 意为“揭露”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻揭露揭出整个事务所的勾当（expose the dealings of the whole office at once），以后再也不要提起。
expose 意为“暴露”，新来的旅人每个日子都照例揭露揭出整个事务所的勾当，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 exposes。
expose 意为“暴露”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地暴露露出第三根梁上的毛病，用一般过去式 exposed 叙述。
expose 意为“暴露”，结尾那句是母亲 1964 年的话：要暴露露出第三根梁上的毛病，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和山谷记住的那一件。

answers: In 1952 the guide exposed the fault in the third beam in silence, and every traveller in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three days on, the guide still exposes the fault in the third beam twice over without being asked.
My mother said later that to expose the fault in the third beam at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had exposed the fault in the third beam long before 1959, and the line in the guidebook for July proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 expose 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the guide exposed the fault in the third beam in silence, and nobody in the valley forgot it.
Even now the guide exposes the fault in the third beam twice over whenever the valley asks.
Exposing the fault in the third beam in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever expose the dealings of the whole office twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next valley exposes the dealings of the whole office in silence every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother exposed the fault in the third beam again, and the valley remembered that half.
